correctness.rationale: For any field, the determinant equations on triangle-plus-leaf edges split into exhaustive cases according to (a,b), then c, then leaf vector. For fixed nonzero triangle minors, SL_2 acts freely and transitively on the 2-by-3 matrices with those minors, giving q(q^2-1), and leaf determinant equations contribute q^r or q^{2r} as specified. Vanishing triangle minors admit the independent rank-one and zero first-vector counts, yielding the complete zero fiber. These equations also prove the excluded image locus and the sharp r=0 versus r>=1 bracket width without a characteristic restriction. Thirteen exhaustive small-field configurations including F4 corroborated every output fiber; finite enumeration was not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The image of a bilinear Lie bracket, its width and its prescribed-target fiber multiplicities are intrinsic, natural invariants not determined by the derived algebra dimension or commuting-pair total. The infinitely many triangle-plus-leaf algebras exhibit a sharp width increase at the first leaf, an explicit geometrically defined excluded locus and complete characteristic-independent arithmetic counts including full-Lie-pair scaling; this is not an arbitrary finite slice or an incremental one-point enumeration.
